title: Cover default ignored-target creation for direct focused Cargo admission
outcome: Add a direct focused Cargo fixture that ignores /target and distinguishes accepted-policy tagged directory creation from refusal-before-creation. Existing refusal fixtures leave target unignored, so absence alone cannot detect ordering regression.
acceptance: A direct focused Cargo check with /target ignored verifies accepted selection creates the tagged default directory before its stage.
The same ignored-target setup verifies refused external/unsupported selection runs no stage and creates no default target.
